name: decktype
description: Create, revise, render, and export editable Decktype presentations with an AI coding agent: PDF on every plan, PowerPoint on Pro and Autonomous plans. Requires the Decktype app on an Apple silicon Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Build editable presentations with your agent.
interface.longDescription: Create structured .deck presentations, preserve human edits, inspect rendered slides, and export a PDF on every plan or a PowerPoint file on Pro and Autonomous plans, from Codex. Requires the Decktype app on an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 11 or newer.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable presentation from this brief.
Revise this Decktype deck without losing my edits.
Render and review this deck, then export it to PDF.
